People search "clankertoken rug or scam or honeypot" a lot. We read the contracts.

A real ClankerToken can't trap your sale: fixed supply, no owner mint, no pause, no blacklist, no tax. The admin can change the logo and metadata. That's it.

The "Clanker Hook" tokens people ask about are genuine Clanker launches (Clanker's own factory registry says so). Most never traded.

Two did. In both, the deployer bought at launch and sold the whole bag within minutes: 26 seconds for one, 4m40s for the other.

The one working trap we found: CLK2, verified on Blockscout as "ClankerToken" but not deployed by Clanker.

Its mint is gated on the L2 bridge. Its bundled Predeploys.sol swaps that address for a contract the deployer owns. It minted 100x the launch supply in four minutes and sold into the pool.

Check one yourself: ignore the contract name, ask Clanker's factory (tokenDeploymentInfo on 0xE85A59c628F7d27878ACeB4bf3b35733630083a9), and read the imported libraries, not just the main file.

Genuine isn't the same as safe. Every figure in the decode is tied to a transaction.
